title: Memory Journey Match
description: Flip scenic illustrated postcards to pair matching travel memories across charming global destinations—train your recall in relaxing stages.
controls: Tap two cards to flip them over and match identical travel scenes until the board is cleared.

zh-CN.title: 记忆旅行翻牌
zh-CN.description: 清新治愈翻牌益智记忆旅行：翻开绝美风景明信片两两配对消除，边锻炼记忆力边畅游梦幻世界！
zh-CN.controls: 点击翻转两张记忆卡片，记住位置将相同图案全部配对消除通关。
